_comment: D126. The call that starts the quest. It replaces the two SMS the prologue
used to open with - ac_msg_unknown_01 and _02, both now gone from
source/journal.json - and it sits in exactly their slot in the graph, between
await_start and quest_active, so the phone still leads and the journal still
follows.
WHY A CALL IS BETTER HERE AND NOT JUST DIFFERENT: the second SMS was a
description of a sound. '[attachment: audio, 2s] It is your voice. Distorted.
Saying words you never said.' A text message can only ever tell the player
about that recording; a call can play it. So the beat the SMS narrated is the
one beat this scene performs, and it is the reason the scene has a second
speaker.
WHO IS CALLING: not established, on purpose. docs/quest_design.md gives the
hook to 'an unknown number' and gives Mr. Blue Eyes his own contact and his own
SMS later, so the question of who made this call is a hole the quest declines
to fill. Nothing in here hints. The caller knows about the scan, the echo and
the burn order, and that is the whole of what the player gets.
WHY NOBODY SPAWNS: scene.holocall makes every non-player actor a VOICE -
findInContext with contextualName 'Voice', the vanilla penthouse-AI shape. See
source/scene_holocall.json, which established this, and characters.json
'_voices' for the two bodiless cast members and why they carry no marker.
WHY NO set_tier: same as D124. A phone call is not a conversation you stand
still for, and q112_03_infiltration brackets two Takemura calls with exactly one
tier node in the whole phase, Tier1_FullGameplay. Here it matters more than it
did in D124, because this call fires at the very start of the quest and the
player could be doing anything at all when it lands.
THE HUB DOES NOT BRANCH. Both options reach the same answer, the pattern
scene_aftertalk.json and scene_holocall.json both use: this is the player's one
chance to react, not a decision. What differs is only whether V asks who is on
the line or says the thing the player is actually thinking.
The caller never answers 'Who is this?'. That is not an oversight to be fixed
later - it is the answer.

nodes._comment: No emotions on any line in this scene. A voice actor is built with facialAnimSets [] and has no head to put an expression on, so an emotion event here would be a performer event addressed to nobody - see gen_scene.py FACIAL_EMOTIONS, which is a set of female facial idles and has nothing to say about either of these two.

lines.en-us: Don't talk. This number stops existing in about a minute, so just listen.
lines.ua-ua: Не говори. Цей номер зникне десь за хвилину, тож просто слухай.

lines.en-us: Cynosure didn't just take your scan in that vault. They kept a piece of the echo they grew off it.
lines.ua-ua: У «Синозурі» не просто зняли твій скан у тому сховищі. Вони лишили собі шматок відлуння, яке з нього виростили.

nodes._comment: The beat the SMS could only describe. hook_echo_1 is the same sentence the old ac_msg_unknown_02 quoted, said out loud this time, and it is rendered in V's OWN voice - tools/render_lines.py maps the actor 'Echo' to the male_v model. That mapping is the whole point and is the one line in this quest that could not be made until the V checkpoint came back.

lines.en-us: Two seconds is all I could pull before it locked me out. Here.
lines.ua-ua: Дві секунди — це все, що я встиг витягнути, поки мене не відрізало. Ось.

nodes._comment: 'It was.' answers opt_voice and pointedly does not answer opt_who. Written to land as an answer either way: after 'Who is this?' the same two words read as a refusal.

lines.en-us: It was. The FIA signs the burn order this week, and after that there's nothing left to come for.
lines.ua-ua: Був. ФІА цього тижня підпише наказ на спалення, і після цього вже не буде по що приходити.

lines.en-us: Dogtown. Ask for the place where dogs sleep. Come without company, and get there before they do.
lines.ua-ua: Доґтаун. Питай про місце, де сплять пси. Приходь без компанії й будь там раніше за них.
